name: linkup
description: Cisco SE LinkUP — mentor/mentee matching demo

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm build:packages && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.models:fetch: node --input-type=module -e "const { LocalEmbeddingProvider } = await import('./packages/embeddings/dist/index.js'); await new LocalEmbeddingProvider().embed(['ok']); console.log('model cached in .cache/models')"
scripts.cf:secret:db: pnpm --filter @linkup/cloudflare-api exec wrangler secret put DATABASE_URL
scripts.cf:deploy:api: pnpm build:packages && pnpm models:fetch && WRANGLER_DOCKER_BIN="$PWD/scripts/podman-docker.sh" DOCKER_HOST="unix://$(podman machine inspect --format '{{.ConnectionInfo.PodmanSocket.Path}}')" pnpm --filter @linkup/cloudflare-api run cf:deploy
